_about: The automation gate for Mars: a plain `--test` runs every test under these roots, plus functional tests and tests named after an enabled plugin/module (UnrealToolbox v1.49+).
Without this file a bare --test skips every Ck.* test: Ck, CkAngelscriptGenerator, CkGrid, CkSubsystemBrowser and CkGoapDebugger are naming roots, not plugin names.

Known reds for a Ck plugin's own tests live in THAT plugin's AutomationGate.json (UnrealToolbox v1.52+), so every project that pulls the plugin judges them alike. This file lists only a plugin test that is red BECAUSE of this project (its content or config, marked HOST-COUPLED), plus reds of tests this project defines.

knownReds.reason: HOST-COUPLED by observation only: a suite-only failure of this renderer-only test seen in Mars (1 of 3 gates), green alone, and green in the CkPlugins gates (2026-10-01/02) and the BusterBlock gate (2026-10-02). No coupling identified; if it also shows in CkPlugins it belongs in the plugin's list instead. Seen: Expected 'physical Graph-tab selection replaces only the page body' to be true.
knownReds.evidence: Mars dev f4d3c25 (CkFoundation 9366c2a34, CkTests 771c2a98, CkGameplayDebugger 5af581da), UnrealToolbox v1.52, 3 full gates on one build 2026-10-03 (G1 raw 4243 run/62 red; G2 judged 4243/62; G3 judged 4243/63) + solo fresh-boot runs: gates GREEN GREEN RED, solo GREEN. The only change under test was adding this file (and docs), so the failure predates it. That change touches no shared state, so green alone here means suite-only.

knownReds.reason: HOST-COUPLED: Mars sets no [/Script/CkSnapshot.Ck_Snapshot_PostureRatchet_Settings] _FragmentNamePrefixes, so the fence refuses to enumerate nothing. Follow-up: give Mars its prefixes (e.g. Mars_Fragment_). Seen: _FragmentNamePrefixes is empty, so this fence would enumerate nothing. Set it in the project's [/Script/CkSnapshot.Ck_Snapshot_PostureRatchet_Settings] config section to the reflected-name prefixes of its script-declared fragments (e.g. Bb_Fragment_, Bb_Tag_).

knownReds.reason: Mars test, scheduling race in the test's premise. It disables a leg from the crawler's Windup signal and expects the native procedural action to still be PendingAdmission; when the attack tick creates the action and the action processor admits it in the same frame, the Windup callback's own assertion ('a real pending action with no accepted receipt') fails and Check_Reported then times out at step 13/15 while the accepted attack plays out. No hook holds the native admission, so the test cannot force the order.

knownReds.reason: HOST-COUPLED to Mars + engine 417f32a755. The test's FState::Close() runs CollectGarbage, which reclaims an AutoTests_Mars_MAP world whose WorldPartitionSubsystem was never deinitialized: handled ensure 'Tickable subsystem WorldPartitionSubsystem ... was destroyed while still initialized' (WorldSubsystem.cpp:118). Green in CkPlugins on the same Ck pins (its map is not World Partition). Inferred cause: the merged engine 417f32a755 (Saad's 5.8 commits); every Mars 5.8 run on the earlier engine 935c5aa08b6d passed it. Owner: engine/Mars; the test is in CkTests.
